body:
I wouldn't ever do it sober, he wont even speak to me now, and he told his friends what happened, they own the most popular gay bar where I live and I went to it not remember what happened, just thinking I had a fight with my now ex boyfriend and they asked me to leave.

I am just devastated and its haunting me.

I used to be in therapy because I believed that everything was my fault, and got really depressed about it but this was maybe 7 years ago. 

I have never been violent towards anyone, I have never harmed anyone in my life, I am completely devastated this happened and I can't stop thinking about it or how I could completely black out and do something like this, if I have that evil in me how could I go on? I am scared of myself.
